title: HostProtocol
description: Generated from protocol/host.tsp. Do not edit.

AcpPayload.title: AcpPayload
AcpPayload.description: ACP payload forwarded unchanged; its shape is owned by the ACP schema.

AppDocumentSchema.title: AppDocumentSchema
AppDocumentSchema.description: Public catalog: no local paths or backend credentials.

AppPreparation.title: AppPreparation
AppPreparation.description: Dependency preparation is separate from backend startup.

AppsPreparationEvent.title: AppsPreparationEvent
AppsPreparationEvent.description: Private acknowledgements intercepted by Desktop main.

ArtifactBrowserState.title: ArtifactBrowserState
ArtifactBrowserState.description: Public UI state, not a second artifact catalog or Host persistence owner.

ArtifactSnapshot.title: ArtifactSnapshot
ArtifactSnapshot.description: Shell-private verified snapshot. The local path never enters the App or Wasm event stream.

ArtifactSnapshotResultEvent.title: ArtifactSnapshotResultEvent
ArtifactSnapshotResultEvent.description: Main/Native-only descriptor response. Shells consume it before forwarding public events.

AutomationCommand.title: AutomationCommand
AutomationCommand.description: Internal execution receipts, reservations and clock ticks are never client commands.

BackendAccess.title: BackendAccess
BackendAccess.description: Host-to-main-process descriptor. Never forwarded to App or Workbench renderers.

Closed.title: Closed
Closed.description: Spread into a model to reject unknown fields, matching serde `deny_unknown_fields`.

ContentDocumentEvent.title: ContentDocumentEvent
ContentDocumentEvent.description: Read-only Desktop result-file transport. It never starts an Agent turn.

DisconnectedEvent.title: DisconnectedEvent
DisconnectedEvent.description: Emitted by Electron when the Host child cannot start or exits.

EnvironmentInspectionApp.title: EnvironmentInspectionApp
EnvironmentInspectionApp.description: Software observations only; does not allocate or approve scientific execution.

InsightsCommand.title: InsightsCommand
InsightsCommand.description: Read one saved session and return its Insights analysis.

InsightsSummary.title: InsightsSummary
InsightsSummary.description: Derived session analysis. Not written into the session journal.

MessageKey.title: MessageKey
MessageKey.description: Catalog key resolved by the UI from locales/*.json.

NoticeEvent.title: NoticeEvent
NoticeEvent.description: Emitted by Electron from the Workbench menu.

PermissionData.title: PermissionData
PermissionData.description: The ACP RequestPermissionRequest plus the Host-issued `permission_id`.

ProjectResourceReference.title: ProjectResourceReference
ProjectResourceReference.description: An App catalog observation; revisions do not claim complete experimental provenance.

RemoteConnectionSettings.title: RemoteConnectionSettings
RemoteConnectionSettings.description: Internal main-process/runtime preferences; never exposed in renderer snapshots.

RemoteOpenEvent.title: RemoteOpenEvent
RemoteOpenEvent.description: Open remote tasks from the native Workbench menu or keyboard.

RemoteSettingsSavedEvent.title: RemoteSettingsSavedEvent
RemoteSettingsSavedEvent.description: Main-process acknowledgements contain no persisted connection payload.

RemoteSnapshotPayload.title: RemoteSnapshotPayload
RemoteSnapshotPayload.description: Main-process HTTP adapter snapshot; validated by protocol/remote.tsp.

ResearchAssetReply.title: ResearchAssetReply
ResearchAssetReply.description: Data owns the domain source/job/catalog documents. The handoff has no private paths or tokens.

ResearchId.title: ResearchId
ResearchId.description: Paper may request only saved research identities; Host owns the fixed Data target.

ResolveStaticApp.title: ResolveStaticApp
ResolveStaticApp.description: Static UI access without dependency preparation or backend startup.

SessionReadyEvent.title: SessionReadyEvent
SessionReadyEvent.description: `data` is the ACP NewSessionResponse, with configOptions refreshed after model selection.

ThreadEvent.title: ThreadEvent
ThreadEvent.description: Events persisted to the session journal and replayed to the UI.

TurnFinishedEvent.title: TurnFinishedEvent
TurnFinishedEvent.description: `text` is the stop reason; `data` is the ACP PromptResponse.

UsageCost.title: UsageCost
UsageCost.description: Provider measurements: context occupancy and cumulative session cost.

WebCommand.title: WebCommand
WebCommand.description: Private Desktop/native browser-engine commands, not Host stdin.
